{{Short description|List of most-followed Instagram accounts}} {{pp-protected|reason=Persistent [[WP:Disruptive editing|disruptive editing]]|small=yes}} {{Use American English|date=June 2020}} {{Use mdy dates|date=December 2020}} {{Dynamic list}} This article is a list of the top 50 accounts with most followers on the photo and video-sharing social platform [[Instagram]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.trackalytics.com/the-most-followed-instagram-profiles/page/1/|title=The Most Followed Instagram Profiles|website=Trackalytics.com|access-date=April 9, 2020|archive-date=July 1, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190701132436/https://www.trackalytics.com/the-most-followed-instagram-profiles/page/1/|url-status=live}}{{Cite web|title=Top 50 Most Followed Instagram Business / Creator Accounts (Sorted by Followers Count)|url=https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/50/followers|access-date=January 2, 2021|website=[[Social Blade]]|archive-date=September 4, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200904174800/https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/50/followers|url-status=live}}{{Cite web|title=Top 50 Most Followed Instagram accounts in 2021 {{!}} TikTokBlade|url=https://insiflow.com/instagram/top|url-status=live|access-date=2021-06-09|website=Social Media Marketing & Management Dashboard|language=en|archive-date=June 9, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210609172357/https://insiflow.com/instagram/top}} {{As of|2022|26|lc=y}}, the most-followed individual is footballer [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] with over 459 million followers, and the most-followed woman is [[reality television]] star [[Kylie Jenner]] with over 353 million followers. Instagram's own brand account on the platform is the most-followed account overall, with over 523 million followers. ''[[National Geographic]]'' is the second most-followed brand account, with over 230 million followers. A total of 34 accounts have exceeded 100 million followers on the platform, with 17 of those having exceeded 200 million followers, 8 of those having exceeded 300 million, 2 exceeding 400 million and 1 exceeding 500 million. ==Most-followed accounts== The following table lists the 50 most-followed accounts on [[Instagram]] {{as of|2022|6|26|df=US|lc=y}},{{Cite web|url=https://www.socialtracker.io/toplists/top-50-instagram-users-by-followers/|title = Top 50 Most Followed Instagram accounts in 2022 | SocialTracker}} with each total rounded down to the nearest million followers, as well as the profession or activity of each user.
